rationale: Positives: The agent verified identity using full name + zip; identified the correct laptop on the user’s own order; presented a concrete replacement variant with item ID; asked for and received explicit confirmation before performing the exchange; and used the user’s stored payment method. Concerns leading to fail: (1) The agent stated the laptop was “delivered” without tool-supported order status. (2) It asserted “The price difference will be refunded” after the exchange despite no tool evidence of pricing or net direction; this is an unsupported claim. (3) The exchange tool’s response did not clearly confirm submission, yet the agent declared success and described next steps. These constitute stating information not supported by tools, which fails the pass criteria.
